title: What sitting all day does
description:
Counting down what a whole day glued to a chair does to your body.
#sitting #deskjob #science #health
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

lines.hook: What happens if you sit all day?
lines.b1: Sitting for hours makes your muscles stiff and your back ache.
lines.b2: The longer you sit, the slower blood flows through your legs.
lines.b3: Your hip muscles can tighten and shorten from sitting too long.
lines.b4: Sitting most of the day is linked to a higher risk of heart disease.
lines.b5: On average, adults spend about six and a half hours a day sitting.
lines.end: So, how many hours did you sit today?
